Package arcade.core.agent.cell

Interface Cell

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
All Known Implementing Classes:
PatchCell, PatchCellCancer, PatchCellCancerStem, PatchCellCART, PatchCellCARTCD4, PatchCellCARTCD8, PatchCellRandom, PatchCellTissue, PottsCell, PottsCellFlyGMC, PottsCellFlyNeuron, PottsCellStem
public interface Cell extends sim.engine.Steppable
A Cell object represents a cell agent.

Each cell is associated with a Location object that defines their physical location. Each cell is also associated with a Module object and/or Process objects that characterizes cellular behaviors and states. The Module or Process object(s) are stepped during the step method of the Cell.
